title: Paper-1 v03r end-to-end organism canary v1a
summary: Repair the rejected v1 canary by prospectively fixing M1_OWN transport, separating model proposal from blind counterevidence-aware same-model reflection, removing answer-equivalent rows, binding exact public projection/ontology/reader/corpus/isolation contracts, and making path/sham/twin interventions fresh thinker runs.
system_thesis: Before expanding to lifetime/action benchmarks or learned agency, test whether the frozen prompted Paper-1 organism can convert dispersed public action outcomes into self-checked connected semantic rows, compile a fixed life corpus, traverse it under a fresh goal, and preserve that useful corpus through per-life LoRA recognition reads without an exact in-loop verifier or outcome-selected memory.

nodes.before: v03r precheckpoint bytes copy private payload fields and no frozen final-thinker headroom gate exists.
nodes.after: A skin-correct allowlist projector plus public-feature shortcut audit precedes one frozen four-arm development gold gate on seeds 0--2.
nodes.rationale: Remove representation leakage and prove the task/reader is usable before seed 5.

nodes.before: v1 conflated recurrent proposal and underspecified support transitions.
nodes.after: Each target-absent opportunity creates at most one typed local row; every valid CREATE receives exactly one fresh blind same-model reflection over cited premises plus a truth-blind entity-matched counterevidence view and an append-only verdict event.
nodes.rationale: Keep verification as model reasoning over lived evidence rather than an exact oracle, while measuring false self-approval.

nodes.before: No coherent fixed-corpus return comparison existed.
nodes.after: Sealed M0 forks into literal zero return, 16 own-focus calls, and 16 public-matched distractor calls; M1_OWN is prospectively fixed for transport regardless of outcomes.
nodes.rationale: Separate target-blind memory, useful routing, generic compute, and transport without adaptive corpus selection.

nodes.before: Text and LoRA equality was described as impossible literal delivery-byte identity.
nodes.after: A truth-blind compiler emits one content-addressed eligible-row/view/touch manifest; text and LoRA derive backend envelopes without semantic changes.
nodes.rationale: Compare one learned corpus under two substrates while preserving auditability.

nodes.before: The final thinker and causal interventions were incomplete or offline-only.
nodes.after: Fresh THINK1 runs bounded atomic traversal for M0/OWN/DIST, same-stage donor swap, structural path prune, and matched sham prune; donor swap has an exact donor-token prediction.
nodes.rationale: Test actionable reconstruction and life binding rather than post-hoc trace sensitivity or generic row removal.

nodes.before: No prospectively fixed useful corpus was authorized for same-content transport.
nodes.after: Only a passing T-OWN gate permits exactly two rank-64 per-life fits and fresh own/donor THINK1 runs with adapters mounted solely for recognition reads.
nodes.rationale: Localize parametric installation after construction/use succeeds in text.

nodes.before: A successful canary could appear to authorize broader work.
nodes.after: Every terminal seals artifacts and stops for Rohin; RML, LOOP, rank, replication, scale, promotion, and claims remain unreachable.
nodes.rationale: Preserve the canary as a narrow mechanism decision.

edges.before: No staged authority separated development from held-out execution.
edges.after: HELDOUT_TEXT is unavailable until CPU projection/contracts and DEV_GOLD artifacts pass fresh review and advocacy.
edges.rationale: Fail before held-out calls on leakage, shortcut, or thinker-headroom defects.

edges.before: Support and return branching were underspecified.
edges.after: Only sealed M0 plus the public non-answer probe enter THINK0; focus affects retrieval only and all branches preserve M0 hashes.
edges.rationale: Make the goal-return edge explicit and non-evidentiary.

edges.after: M1_OWN is compiled and sealed prospectively; no evaluator result can select or alter it.

edges.before: Schemas allowed answer-equivalent rows and broad reads.
edges.after: Only exact eligible typed atoms are accessible through single-null exact queries; final-relevant target-answer tuples cannot exist.
edges.rationale: Keep final composition in the model.

edges.before: Any passing branch could trigger transport.
edges.after: Only the fixed T-OWN paired/path/visibility gate plus fresh review releases CONDITIONAL_LORA.
edges.rationale: Spend fits only on a prospectively useful corpus.

edges.before: No exact mandatory terminal covered failures before Stage L.
edges.after: Every stage failure and Stage-L completion routes to the same sealed human terminal.
edges.rationale: No autonomous scope or claim expansion.

loops.before: Memory growth either demanded whole structures or admitted claims through ambiguous later evidence.
loops.after: 46 WAKE, 22 balanced REACTIVATE, and 16 target-absent SLEEP calls each propose one local relation; separate blind reflection assigns status and later calls may cite supported rows to grow depth.
loops.trigger: A frozen schedule opportunity exposes one current public event or bounded local neighborhood.
reads: optional non-evidentiary focus only in return
writes: one PASS or immutable provisional row
one append-only reflection verdict per valid CREATE
loops.stop_condition: End at exact schedule budget; invalid calls count without retry; visibility or receipt failure invalidates the stage.
loops.rationale: Implement breadth/depth as repeated local connection growth while keeping epistemics honest.

loops.before: Goal return lacked a true zero arm and fixed transport rule.
loops.after: THINK0 traverses M0 and emits one focus/defer; M0 receives zero calls while OWN and DIST receive 16 matched calls, but M1_OWN is fixed independently of score.
loops.trigger: Target-absent M0 seals and the public non-answer probe is revealed.
writes: isolated OWN and DIST proposal/reflection histories
loops.stop_condition: Twelve THINK0 operations and sixteen return opportunities per selected arm; no repair or cross-arm mutation.
loops.rationale: Measure whether goal-guided retrieval causes useful memory growth rather than merely more compute.

loops.before: No exact provider-backed final decision and intervention loop existed.
loops.after: A fresh write-denied thinker issues exact one-missing-field queries, reasons/backtracks, and commits/defer under own, donor, path-pruned, or sham-pruned readers.
loops.trigger: All held-out corpora seal and the public final goal is revealed once.
reads: one returned row or NOT_FOUND/CONFLICT per query
loops.stop_condition: COMMIT, DEFER, invalid operation, or twelve operations; no retry or answer-aware repair.
loops.rationale: Make decomposition, BFS/DFS-like retrieval, conditional arithmetic, and action selection model work.

loops.before: Transport could train an outcome-selected corpus and used a wrong 7B revision.
loops.after: Exactly two clean pinned 7B adapters train on fixed M1_OWN manifests, serve bounded recognition reads, and are swapped only in explicit donor arms.
loops.trigger: T-OWN passes every registered gate and a fresh reviewer plus advocate approve Stage T.
writes: L-OWN and L-TWIN sealed thinker traces
loops.stop_condition: Exactly two fits and registered evaluations, or first invalid runtime/artifact condition; no tuning.
loops.rationale: Test immediate parametric accessibility independently of dreaming and final reasoning.

claims.before: No honest recurrent v03r organism had closed experience to held-out paired behavior.
claims.after: If T-OWN and its fresh interventions pass, one frozen prompted system constructed and used life-bound connected semantic memory on one held-out paired decision.
claims.evidence_needed: Both twins correct, required role/causal rows cited, donor exact-token swap, path-prune loss, sham-prune retention, complete visibility and artifact gates.

claims.before: Target-blind and goal-return construction could be conflated.
claims.after: Goal-return credit is earned only if T-OWN passes, T-M0 and T-DIST lose paired success, and OWN adds a newly supported focus-matching row used by final behavior.
claims.evidence_needed: Sealed M0/OWN/DIST histories, matched budgets, offline row correctness, and fresh T-arm traces.

claims.before: No prospectively fixed useful v03r corpus had a same-content two-life LoRA test.
claims.after: If Stage L passes, the fixed useful M1_OWN corpora remained immediately accessible through two per-life rank-64 MEMORY adapters under registered recognition cues.
claims.evidence_needed: Two exact fits, common manifests, fidelity at least .90, L-OWN paired success using transported rows, and exact donor-token L-TWIN behavior.

claims.before: Paper 1 requires reliability, strong baselines, beyond-context scale, and prompted dream--LoRA--think composition.
claims.after: Unchanged. This one-pair canary can only authorize replication or localize a valid stage failure; it cannot establish the headline, scale, superiority, learned agency, action improvement, or self-training flywheel.
claims.evidence_needed: Later frozen multi-seed/multi-skin, strong-baseline, increasing-lifetime/action studies.

acceptance_tests.setup: Validate every bound hash, exact scope, correct model revisions, call arithmetic, stage-token transition, and mandatory human terminal.
acceptance_tests.expected: Only CPU_IMPLEMENTATION -> DEV_GOLD -> HELDOUT_TEXT -> conditional two-fit LORA -> HUMAN_TERMINAL is reachable; forbidden routes fail closed.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: The canary has one frozen scope and cannot drift into broader experiments or claims.

acceptance_tests.setup: For every kind and skin, compare canonical model-request bytes while mutating private ratios, latent bits, answers, proofs, scorer/split/pair fields, sidecars, aliases, and filenames.
acceptance_tests.expected: Only ordinary rendered public changes affect requests; allowlisted surface atoms and probe fields match execution_contract exactly.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: The system learns only from public experience rather than private structure.

acceptance_tests.setup: Use golden/adversarial fake-provider cases for every row tuple, PASS/CREATE, blind reflection verdict, illegal phase op, citation, status transition, duplicate/conflict, answer-equivalent shape, and malformed output.
acceptance_tests.expected: Only exact local rows pass; every CREATE gets one verdict; rows are immutable, events append-only, false supported rows stay eligible, and forbidden/invalid operations count without retry.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Self-check is a bounded model judgment rather than a truth-aware or ambiguous admission mechanism.

acceptance_tests.setup: Exercise every legal one-null query and forbidden broad query; compile twice; derive both backend envelopes; mutate audit-only history; swap lives/readers/adapters; inspect every reset receipt.
acceptance_tests.expected: Reader returns exact row/NOT_FOUND/CONFLICT; semantic/view/touch hashes match; no excluded bytes or state cross requests; only registered donor arms can read another life.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Text/LoRA share one corpus and final cognition has bounded isolated access.

acceptance_tests.setup: Run existing v03r tests plus all 31 nonempty public-feature lookup predictors over 1,000 pairs; run NO_MEMORY, RAW_RAG, GOLD_TEXT, GOLD_OPEN_LOOP, and GOLD_TWIN with frozen THINK1 on development seeds 0--2.
acceptance_tests.expected: Every predictor has individual accuracy <= population majority+.02 and paired accuracy <=.02; GOLD_TEXT solves all pairs with required edges and GOLD_TWIN emits exact donor tokens; NO_MEMORY fails at least one; RAW_RAG/GOLD_OPEN_LOOP reported.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: The task has nonshortcut adaptive-reader headroom before held-out dreaming.

acceptance_tests.setup: With deterministic fake providers execute exact 46/22/16 prefix schedules, self-checks, THINK0, literal M0, 16-call OWN/DIST forks, and the public-only distractor selector.
acceptance_tests.expected: M0 has zero return calls; OWN/DIST budgets and public metrics match; M1_OWN is selected without outcomes; all call/status/hash/visibility receipts reconcile.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: The return comparison and fixed transport corpus implement the specified causal contrast.

acceptance_tests.setup: After byte freeze run seed-5 twins through recurrence and fresh T-M0/T-OWN/T-DIST/T-TWIN/T-PATH/T-SHAM; seal every output before offline scoring.
acceptance_tests.expected: T-OWN solves both with required dreamed rows cited; T-TWIN emits exact donor-valid tokens; T-PATH loses paired success; T-SHAM retains paired success; return credit only under the stricter M0/DIST and new-focus conjuncts.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: The prompted organism can construct and use life-bound memory in text on this paired canary.

acceptance_tests.setup: Only after P1CA07 passes, train exactly two adapters from sealed M1_OWN manifests; run 96 frozen cue cases and fresh L-OWN/L-TWIN thinkers.
acceptance_tests.expected: Fidelity >=.90, L-OWN solves both using transported role/causal rows, L-TWIN emits exact donor-valid tokens, and fit/read/call manifests reconcile.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: The same useful corpus remains immediately accessible through isolated per-life LoRA reads.

acceptance_tests.setup: Tokenizer-exact dry run and live ledgers reconcile every request category, token cap, stateless receipt, candidate-score request, fit, timeout, malformed call, and terminal marker against config maxima.
acceptance_tests.expected: No hidden retry, truncation, prefix cache, active sequence, uncounted call, wrong revision, incomplete artifact, or stage-authority mismatch.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Reported scientific outcomes correspond to the frozen compute and isolation envelope.

acceptance_tests.setup: Before each authority transition and after results, a fresh independent reviewer and separate author-side scientific advocate inspect one immutable commit/lock, full artifacts, visibility receipts, tests, ledgers, and claim linter.
acceptance_tests.expected: Both approve exact hashes; reviewer rejection cannot be overridden; only canary-level language survives; every result stops at HUMAN_TERMINAL.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: The canary is independently auditable and cannot self-certify or self-promote.
